correctness.rationale: For odd order, preservation of 2y−x forces each arbitrary quandle homomorphism to be affine by invertibility of multiplication by 2. Composition-idempotence is equivalent to a group projection plus a translation in its kernel. Group projections are exactly ordered direct-sum decompositions, with type counted by an independently derived automorphism-group formula and orbit–stabilizer. The rank-p coefficient follows algebraically from the (0,1) decomposition type, and its monotonicity reconstructs the group. The standalone checker exhaustively enumerates all additive maps and directly checks the small quandle operation; finite checks corroborate but do not prove the general formula.

value.rationale: The underlying mathematical question is whether a highly compressed enumerative invariant recovers the finite abelian group, motivated by known reconstruction from the entire Takasaki subquandle lattice. A single nontrivial low-rank coefficient plus top degree reconstructs every group in a natural infinite mixed-exponent p-primary family; the exact type-refined count and gap criterion explain the phenomenon. This is an inverse-classification theorem, not an isolated small-group calculation or renaming.
